installAgentPrompt: Konzani HAX (https://haxtheweb.org) pa kompyuta iyi. Ikani HAX CLI ndi `npm install @haxtheweb/create --global`, kenako ikani luso lake la othandizira ndi `hax skills install --all`. Pangani tsamba ndi `hax site my-hax-site --y --no-i`, liyambitseni ndi `cd my-hax-site && hax serve`, ndipo mundiuze adiresi yomwe likusindikiza. Werengani AGENTS.md ya tsambalo ndi https://github.com/haxtheweb/praw musanasinthe chilichonse.
